verification.precondition: A live new Survey workspace has frozen intake and policy heads, exact authoring new and phase initialized machine heads, valid authority, and a recoverably blocked adapter state.
verification.stimulus: Execute tests/survey/initialization/initialization-adapter-retry.test.mjs with node:test, supply a typed ready result after the recoverable wait, and repeat the accepted ready result.
verification.expectedSemanticState: Ready commits exactly authoring AT01 and phase T02 in one journal record, leaves openAssignment null, derives runtimeStatus active only from that verified postimage, and replays without a second commit.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The immutable adapter history contains the recoverable wait followed by one activation whose command, receipt, commit revision, postimage, dependency result, and exact authority are digest-bound.
verification.forbiddenMutation: Initialization must not emit a runtime-machine edge, create an Assignment or sidecar, split AT01 from T02, expose active before postimage verification, or append a commit on accepted replay.

behavior: recoverable dependency retry commits exactly AT01 plus T02 once and derives active only from that postimage
